description_en: Creates a custom cloud computer template. A cloud computer template is a collection of cloud computer configurations that reduces the configuration steps and accelerates the creation of cloud computers
description_zh: 创建一个自定义的云电脑模板。云电脑模板（简称模板）是云电脑配置的合集，用于减少创建云电脑时的配置步骤，加快创建云电脑的速度
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-template --template-name My_cloud_desktop_template_001 --description Design_department_template --product-type CloudDesktop --biz-type 1 --system-disk-size 80 --system-disk-performance-level AutoPL --data-disk-list Size=40 PerformanceLevel=AutoPL --image-id desktopimage-windows-server-2022-64-asp --default-language zh-CN --policy-group-id pg-8hlryfn331000000 --timer-group-id ccg-0caoeogrk9m50000 --resource-group-id rg-4knxmfneq1e000000 --resource-tag-list Value=design Key=department --region-config-list OfficeSiteId=cn-hangzhou+dir-709000000 SnapshotPolicyId=sp-35fvn8m21pnx20000 VolumeEncryptionEnable=false ResourceInstanceType=eds.enterprise_office.8c16g VolumeEncryptionKey=a7b3c0c8-b3a2-4876-b1cc-000000000 RegionId=cn-hangzhou SubnetId=vsw-bp1yiu0000000000 --site-config-list SiteId=mainland AppRuleId=bwr-5a5371e0db954d00000000 --charge-type example-string --period 1 --period-unit example-string --auto-pay true --auto-renew true --user-duration 1 --post-paid-after-used-up true --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The name of the template. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name must be 2 to 126 characters in length and can contain letters and Chinese characters.
The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The name can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-). Periods (.) are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
模板的名称。必须符合以下要求：

长度2~126个英文或中文字符。
必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
可以包含字母、数字、汉字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或短划线（-），不支持点号（.）
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the template. The description must meet the following requirements:

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
The description can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, spaces, and special characters. Line breaks are supported
parameters.help_zh:
模板的描述。必须符合以下要求：

长度2~256个字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
支持中文、英文、数字、空格和特殊符号，使用回车换行
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The product type. Set the value to `CloudDesktop`
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.help_zh: 该参数暂不对外开放使用
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en:
The system disk size. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 40 to 500. The value must be a multiple of 10.

The system disk size cannot be smaller than the image size
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘大小。单位：GiB。取值范围: 40~500，每10GiB为一个步长。

系统盘大小不能小于配置的镜像大小
parameters.name: system_disk_size

parameters.help_en:
The system disk type.

Only high-frequency and GPU-accelerated cloud computer specifications support ESSD disks
parameters.help_zh:
系统盘类型。

只有高主频和图形型的云电脑规格支持ESSD类型的磁盘
parameters.name: system_disk_performance_level

fields.help_en:
The data cloud disk size. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 40 to 2040. The value must be a multiple of 10.

<notice>The larger the standard SSD or ESSD cloud disk capacity, the higher the performance level (PL) available (for example, PL2 is available for capacities of 460 GiB or above). A higher performance level (PL) incurs higher costs. Select the ESSD cloud disk performance level (PL) based on your requirements.></notice>
fields.help_zh:
系统盘大小。单位：GiB。取值范围: 40~2040，每10GiB为一个步长。

<notice>ESSD云盘容量越大，可供选择的“性能级别”越高 (例如460GiB以上可选PL2)。性能级别越高，费用也越高，请根据您的使用需求合理选择ESSD云盘性能级别。></notice>
fields.name: size

fields.help_en: The data disk performance level. Default value: `AutoPL`
fields.help_zh: 数据盘性能等级，默认为`AutoPL`
fields.name: performance_level
